positive_edge_definition: the five registered S0->S1->S2->S3->S4->S0 cycle edges
negative_edge_definition: all other directed non-self candidate edges

operating_region_class_rules.exact_cycle_no_extra_edges: all five registered edges supported, no unsupported directed edge supported, reconstructed best-edge cycle is the registered cycle, and no ambiguity prevents classification
operating_region_class_rules.exact_cycle_with_extra_edges: registered best-edge cycle is recovered but at least one unsupported directed edge is also forward-supported
operating_region_class_rules.partial_cycle: some but not all registered cycle edges are recovered as supported or selected
operating_region_class_rules.ambiguous_cycle: direction ambiguity or tie structure prevents a unique cycle classification
operating_region_class_rules.cycle_not_recovered: registered cycle is not recovered and ambiguity is not the primary reason
operating_region_class_rules.insufficient_information: inputs or score definition do not permit the metric to be computed
